## Overview

### Product Information on Appspace

Updated 23rd January 2026

#### What is Appspace?

Appspace helps employees feel more connected to the organization and to each other, no matter where they work. It brings company updates, communities, and employee stories into one personalized experience that’s easy to access on desktop and mobile. And with Appspace supporting communications across multiple channels, important messages can stay consistent across the intranet, mobile, and workplace screens – helping more employees stay included and in the know.

#### Appspace Pricing

Appspace software uses a subscription-based pricing model with different plans based on features and user needs the software typically includes options for monthly or annual payments and pricing tiers determined by the number of users devices or locations additional features and support may be available at higher pricing levels

## About Company

### Company Description

Appspace is the workplace experience platform that keeps everyone in the know. We offer a single platform for employee communications, digital signage, space reservation, visitor management, and more, making work an experience everyone loves. Headquartered in the U.S., the Appspace team works across multiple geographies, including the U.S., Canada, Malaysia, Spain, Portugal, and the UAE. More than 160 Fortune 500 companies and 12 million on-site, remote, and frontline employees rely on Appspace every day to make their workplaces more efficient, collaborative, and productive.
